decision.reason: minfreq25 is a coherent but interior support/segmentation operating point after legal16k and legal40k both missed 41.8; A02 is already pursuing support-floor/equal-word evidence, so A01 should avoid duplicating the vocabulary axis.
decision.selected_a01_new_factor_route: legal40k compact_view_reinvest true 12x384/1280 fixed-WWM seed43022 first
decision.scientific_purpose: Test whether depth-over-width / leader geometry repairs relational and stateful columns that a wide 8x480 legal40k model did not, while preserving the compact-view data mechanism and avoiding vocabulary interpolation.
decision.why_not_sequence_curriculum_yet: Inspection showed the existing seq_len_schedule implementation slices already-tokenized 256-token rows while charging full row words; it is not yet a faithful leader-style batch-scaled 64->256 curriculum.
decision.why_not_relationboost_first: Relation boost 2.0 is audited, but legal40k already recovered some EWoK while the largest loss was GlobalPIQA; use it later if depth/curriculum leave selective EWoK/COMPS/Entity deficits.
